Vendored third-party libraries (used for on-device photo conversion):
- libheif.js (libheif compiled to JavaScript) - LGPL-3.0, https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
  Unmodified library, dynamically loaded; source available at the project above.
- jpeg-js - BSD-3-Clause, https://github.com/jpeg-js/jpeg-js

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
onnxruntime-web (Microsoft) — MIT License.
  vendor/onnxruntime-web/ — the WebAssembly build (single-threaded SIMD
  kernel plus its Node entry point), and the onnxruntime-common library it
  requires, both v1.29.0 as published on npm and unmodified. Chosen over the
  native binding because it needs no Visual C++ runtime, which a freshly
  installed Windows lacks.

U^2-Net ("u2netp") — Apache License 2.0.
  Qin et al., "U2-Net: Going Deeper with Nested U-Structure for Salient
  Object Detection" (Pattern Recognition, 2020).
  vendor/models/u2netp.onnx — weights as distributed by the rembg project
  (Daniel Gatis, MIT License). Used locally, on the family's own machine,
  to cut clothing photos out of their background. No image is uploaded.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
Speech activity weights — MIT License.
  vendor/models/chat-activity.onnx — the unmodified 16 kHz recurrent speech
  activity export from https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad, distributed by
  https://k2-fsa.github.io/sherpa/onnx/vad/silero-vad.html .
  SHA-256: 9e2449e1087496d8d4caba907f23e0bd3f78d91fa552479bb9c23ac09cbb1fd6
  License and original copyright are retained in chat-activity.LICENSE.
  It classifies held audio locally before an optional cloud transcription.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
yt-dlp — Unlicense (public domain).
  vendor/yt-dlp/yt-dlp.exe — the standalone Windows build (it carries its own
  Python), unmodified, from the release pinned in tools/yt-dlp.pin and
  verified against that release's published sha256 at build time. It runs
  only on this machine, only when someone adds a song from a link.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
WebP decoder — jSquash WebP 1.5.0, Apache-2.0 wrapper and BSD-3-Clause codec.
  vendor/webp-decoder/webp_dec.mjs and webp_dec.wasm are the unmodified decoder
  from @jsquash/webp 1.5.0 (the JavaScript suffix is changed to .mjs).
  Package source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@jsquash/webp/-/webp-1.5.0.tgz
  Package integrity: sha512-KggLoj2MnRSfIqTeKe1EmbljTX2vuV7mh79k89PCL1pyqiDULcPM1L47twxXt0hkb68F70bXiL31MxsuoZtKFw==
  Upstream: https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash/tree/main/packages/webp
  Both licenses are retained beside the decoder. It decodes downloaded video
  preview sheets locally in a worker; it needs no native runtime or video tool.
